exposure: complementary alternative methods (CAMs) use during labor
cohort: The study included 391 volunteer pregnant women from a university hospital in Turkiye, with data collected during late pregnancy (37-41 weeks) and postpartum.
finding: Postpartum women using complementary alternative methods (CAMs) during delivery experienced less fear of birth and reported higher birth satisfaction.
cross-section timing: Data was collected during pregnancy (37-41 weeks) and at the end of delivery (postpartum).
